newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's High-Speed Railways completes share issue.
newsitem.headline: Russia's High-Speed Railways completes share issue.

text.p: Russia's High-Speed Railways said on Wednesday it had nearly finished placing a new share issue, comprising 50 million ordinary shares.

RAO Vysokoskorostnye Magistrali (VSM) finance specialist Svetlana Smirnova said buyers of the paper, launched on November 30, were current shareholders including commercial banks, the government and private investors.
The company will hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on December 20 to decide whether to raise its authorised capital by 50 billion roubles to 250 billion roubles.
The government owns about 95 percent of the VSM, which hopes to build a high-speed rail linking Moscow and St Petersburg.
